sql: with m as (select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, market_ticker, avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100 as c_per_ct, max(closed_at) as closed from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 93 and 95 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-11' group by 1,2) select series, count(*) as mkts, round(avg(c_per_ct)::numeric,2) as c_per_ct, round(sum(case when c_per_ct<0 then 1 else 0 end)::numeric/count(*)*100,1) as loss_pct, round(min(c_per_ct)::numeric,1) as worst, max(closed)::date as last from m group by series having count(*)>=8 order by mkts desc limit 120
